---
title: Workflow entry
---

An `ae` workflow runs on one fixed graph: one stereoisomer of a species, or one TS channel.
The user starts from SMILES, and the first step turns it into the distinct, fully determined
graphs, one workflow each.

## A species: SMILES to stereoisomers

::: {.callout-note}
Planned: Phase 1, Step 4 (`from_smiles`) and Phase 5 (`stereoisomers`).
:::

```python
import protomol as pm

gra = pm.from_smiles("CC(O)CC")        # butan-2-ol, centre not specified
pm.is_determined(gra)                  # False: C1 has an undetermined Tetrahedral
for smg in pm.stereoisomers(gra):      # (R) and (S), as two determined graphs
    run_species_workflow(smg)          # ae, illustrative
```

Until then, the same enumeration by hand, for a graph with one centre (CHFClBr):

```python
>>> import protomol as pm
>>> gra = pm.StereoMolGraph(
...     symbols=["C", "F", "Cl", "Br", "H"],
...     bonds=[(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (0, 4)],
...     atom_stereo=[pm.Tetrahedral(atoms=(0, 1, 2, 3, 4))],
... )
>>> pm.is_determined(gra)
False
>>> ls = pm.stereo_at(gra, 0)
>>> ls.parity is None
True
>>> isomers = [pm.with_stereo(gra, ls_) for ls_ in pm.isomers(ls)]
>>> [pm.is_determined(smg) for smg in isomers]
[True, True]
>>> [smg.atom_stereo[0].parity for smg in isomers]
[1, -1]
>>> isomers[0] == isomers[1]
False

```

A species given with full stereo needs no expansion:

```python
gra = pm.from_smiles("C[C@@H](O)/C=C/C")   # one stereoisomer of pent-3-en-2-ol
pm.is_determined(gra)                       # True
```

## A reaction: reactant and product SMILES to TS channels

::: {.callout-note}
Planned: Phase 1, Step 5 (`ts_graphs`, stereo carried over) and Phase 5 (stereo
expansion of the TS, fleeting stereo).
:::

```python
rct = pm.from_smiles("CC.[OH]")
prd = pm.from_smiles("C[CH2].O")
for srg in pm.ts_graphs(rct, prd):     # one StereoReactionGraph per distinct channel
    for ts in pm.stereoisomers(srg):   # Phase 5: TS stereoisomers, fleeting stereo
        run_ts_workflow(ts)            # ae, illustrative
```

The reactants and products are each one graph, which may hold several molecules
(`"CC.[OH]"`). The atoms of every channel follow the reactant graph's order.

## Atom-mapped reaction SMILES (the INCITE import)

::: {.callout-note}
Planned: Phase 2 (pm P29). Its name and atom order follow stereomol (D1).
:::

```python
rxn = pm.from_reaction_smiles("[CH3:1][H:2].[OH:3]>>[CH3:1].[H:2][OH:3]")  # PROPOSED: name
```
